## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      7 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 15 jul 2026 - 10 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Db_, 8 sept 2026, 1/5: "This is a open source app and opensource apps always comes with lot of bugs and problem i have never seen an open source app that works flawless. they just can get it right. Normally opening excel and pdf is fine but once they are being encrypted with a password it won't work or it will jump back to the beginning of the the sheet."
            2. _Jim_, 15 jul 2026, 2/5: "The PDF format is not listed amongst the supported document types. Furthermore, the app has major problems when closing documents; it either takes an age to do so or freezes completely and crashes. And whilst using the app, pages – even though they have already loaded correctly and are still visible via their thumbnails – often become inaccessible after just a few seconds. Even scrolling manually does not display the individual page."
            3. _Cringe Guy_, 6 sept 2026, 3/5: "App needs serious attention and care. It's getting unusable and annoying. Bugs, crashes and freezes making it hard to work on this app. This is the only .odf format android app and it is being neglected. This is sad and disappointing."
<!--/ir-theme-->
